scope: Sanitized source-only VM reset recovery update

tests.gateway: go test -mod=readonly -race ./... and go vet: passed
tests.recovery: go test -mod=readonly -race ./... and go vet: passed
tests.collector_reporting: go test -race ./... -count=1 -timeout 180s and go vet: passed
tests.source_manifest: All allowlisted file sizes and SHA-256 verified by rebuilt dot-recovery
tests.publication_scan: Reviewed new/modified source; no private identifiers, workspace paths, Library references, credential values or credential hashes added

limits: Synthetic/offline tests only; no actual credential installation or live service changes
No VM reset, OS boot, self-wake or model-restart guarantee
No live Discord writes or automatic scheduler registration
Old private snapshots remain bound to their exact original source manifests
Publisher recovery requires separately reconciled matching private fences
No GitHub Actions workflow configured at verification time
